scenes.title: the alarm
scenes.summary: A man silences the same alarm he has silenced for a decade.

scenes.title: the corridor
scenes.summary: He walks the same corridor into the same grey day.

scenes.title: the demand
scenes.summary: The supervisor asks for it sooner; he says yes.

scenes.title: the empty room
scenes.summary: The room empties and nothing is asked of him.

scenes.title: the alarm again
scenes.summary: The alarm returns; this time he lets it ring.
